known_misread: remind_request is true beside the leads, and type is event rather than correction: the model reads "avisame 2 horas antes" as a request to be reminded of the event it names. Harmless as read: the reading names referent A, and a bound remind-me binds whatever its type (ADR-0044 point 3); leads win (ADR-0043), so the bound reading takes the correction path and the stray request is ignored (TestI40_LeadsWinOverAStrayRemindRequest, which replays this very reading); no unit is stored and the user gets the item reminded 2 hours before
